<function name="GetTabHeight" parent="DTab" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Returns the target height of this tab. Used internally by <page>DTab</page>'s <page>PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Either 20, or 28 if <page>DTab:IsActive</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
